Idempotency-Replayed.description: Present, with the value `true`, ONLY when this answer is the stored replay of an earlier request that used the same `Idempotency-Key` (the handler did not run again). The first execution never carries it.

Location.description: Path of the newly created package, e.g. `/packages/{id}`.

fragileHandling.description: Derived at seal time from the owning Pack task's `fragile` flag (not an independent input to seal-package) — true if any of the package's scanned/sealed contents came from an order line classified Fragile upstream.

giftWrapRequested.description: Derived at seal time from the owning Pack task's `giftWrap` flag (not an independent input to seal-package, and not restated by the station) — true if the order this package fulfils was flagged for gift wrap at work-enqueue time. Unlike hazmat, this is a packing concern only: it does not gate which station may fulfil the order (see ADR-0011).

sortLane.description: Package's derived WES-tier sortation routing decision (see [ADR-0010](/docs/adr/0010-package-segregation-and-sort-lane)): `HAZMAT_LANE` if any scanned item carried a DOT hazard class from the live per-scanned-item classification lookup, else `FRAGILE_NO_TILT` if `fragileHandling` is true, else `STANDARD`. A decision only — no WCS device/conveyor integration exists in this service; a real WCS system would consume this value as its own inbound fact.
sortLane.title: SortLane

shipInOwnContainer.description: Present (always `true`) only when the package ships in its own container (ADR-0056); omitted from an ordinary carton.

containerSource.description: What a package ships in when it is not a cartonised carton. `CASE`: the SKU's own sealed case (ADR-0056).
containerSource.title: ContainerSource

container.description: The case a package ships in (ADR-0056): its GTIN and the declared dimensions and weight of the case level, copied at seal time (a later re-declaration does not change a sealed package).
container.title: OwnContainer

409.description: One of: `stationId` has no active claim on this task — it was never claimed, or the lease has expired, whichever station held it (`task-not-claimed`, the same type `complete` and `lease-renewals` return for that condition; [ADR-0038](/docs/adr/0038-seal-package-expired-lease-is-not-claimed)); an ACTIVE lease on the task is held by a different station (`task-not-owner`); or a scanned item's live DOT hazard classification lookup found it incompatible — per the class-level 49 CFR §177.848-derived segregation matrix — with an item already scanned into this same package (`package-segregation-violation`, see [ADR-0010](/docs/adr/0010-package-segregation-and-sort-lane)). The segregation check only runs when the deployment has `PRODUCT_CLASSIFICATION_MODE=kafka` configured (a local copy of product-master's classifications, [ADR-0039](/docs/adr/0039-product-classification-local-copy)); the default permissive mode never rejects on this basis. The same `Idempotency-Key` reused with a different method, path or body is also a 409, problem type `idempotency-key-reused`.

422.description: The task is not a Pack task (`wrong-task-type`), or `contents` was empty (nothing was scanned, so there is nothing to seal: `package-no-scanned-contents`), or a `shipInOwnContainer` request cannot ship in a case, in which case nothing is sealed: `ship-in-own-container-not-single-line` (`contents` is not exactly one SKU), `ship-in-own-container-quantity-mismatch` (`lineQuantity` is not the `unitsPerPack` of the SKU's active CASE level), `ship-in-own-container-no-case-level` (the local pack-level copy holds no CASE level in effect for the SKU), `ship-in-own-container-case-retired` (the SKU's CASE level is end-dated) or `ship-in-own-container-case-dimensions-unknown` (the case was declared without dimensions and weight).
